responsibility: Provides the Darwin 12.x version-specific configuration fragment used to specialize the generic Darwin target for the Mac OS X 10.8 era. In this file the specialization is limited to selecting the default minimum deployment target string and the default ld64 toolchain version threshold associated with that OS release. It serves as a small versioned policy header consumed by Darwin target configuration, not as an implementation file for Mach-O code generation or option parsing.
